roles.name: Financial analyst
roles.subtitle: Turn financial experience into clearer business decisions.
roles.sdg_reason: Builds analysis skills and supports effective use of financial technology.
roles.qualification: Professional roles may require a relevant degree or additional finance credentials. Check local employer requirements.

roles.name: Business intelligence analyst
roles.subtitle: Make data understandable, useful and actionable.
roles.sdg_reason: Develops digital reporting skills that help organisations use information productively.
roles.qualification: SQL, visualisation and analytical project experience are common entry expectations.

roles.name: Compliance officer
roles.subtitle: Bring your attention to detail into risk and compliance.
roles.sdg_reason: Develops review and control capabilities for responsible use of technology.
roles.qualification: Sector-specific regulatory knowledge or professional qualifications may be needed.

roles.name: Sustainability specialist
roles.subtitle: Connect reporting strengths with sustainability information.
roles.sdg_reason: Sustainability information and disclosure skills can support company sustainability reporting under target 12.6.
roles.qualification: This direction needs additional sustainability knowledge; it is not an immediate qualification for ESG assurance.

roles.name: Payroll specialist
roles.subtitle: Build on accurate records, checks and employee support.
roles.sdg_reason: Strengthens accurate payroll operations alongside changing workplace technology.
roles.qualification: Local payroll, tax and employment requirements need specific training.
